|strategy=By [mailto:rougeGunn@aol.com Phil Lichterman]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020804022500/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/small/rebelguard.html</ref>

This card makes a great combo with Cz-3 if you have leftover force and a few rebel guards in your hand. Have Cz-3 where you think your opponent will initiate a Battle, When they initiate a battle then you say react and deploy as many Rebel Guards as you can. Each one is worth 4 in power if in a defending battle.
